title: 3 Step Parallel Park Trick for Student Drivers
hook: Stop failing your driving test over parallel parking!

script.narration: Stop failing your driving test over parallel parking! Use this exact visual hack to pass on your first try.
script.visual_search: car parallel parking between two vehicles

script.narration: First, pull up next to the front car until your rear bumpers align. Turn your steering wheel all the way toward the curb and reverse at a forty-five degree angle.
script.visual_search: driver turning steering wheel close up

script.narration: Stop when you can see the rear car's headlight in your side mirror. Straighten your wheel and back straight up until your front bumper clears their rear bumper.
Finally, turn your wheel fully the opposite direction and smoothly reverse into the space. You will align perfectly with the curb every single time.

description:
